source_text.body:
Fill tourist visa applications on government portals
AI agents operate a browser on official government portals to fill visa applications, check documents, and book appointments, with human expert review of each file.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Veeza's AI agents drive a web browser the way a person would, one application at a time, on the official government portals. They fill in the application, check supporting documents, and look for and book visa-centre appointments. The applicant sees a form preview before anything is submitted. A human visa expert reviews every file before submission.
How it went
The page gives no outcome numbers. It says the AI is strong at form filling, document review and finding open slots, but it doesn't guarantee approval, and it isn't legal advice.
Worth knowing
Government visa fees are paid separately, directly to the government. For queue-based countries, the visa centre fee is charged only after the appointment is booked.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
I'm a [your nationality] citizen applying for a [country] [visa type] visa. Go to the official [country] government visa portal, fill in the application using the details I give you, and list every document I need to upload and any appointment slots available near [your city]. Stop and show me the full filled-in form and any fees before you submit anything, pay, or book an appointment.
Original source: https://www.veeza.ai/en/about
